verses.1: To David, I bless my soul with the name of Jehovah. And to all my followers, I give them His holy name.
verses.2: I bless my soul to the Lord, and I will not forget all His commandments.
verses.3: The healer for all my enemies, the one who cures all my illnesses.
verses.4: The redeemer from the bondage of my own life, who surrounds me with kindness and compassion.
verses.5: The good things will be restored to you, as your days of youth are renewed.
verses.6: He performs righteousness and judgments for all people.
verses.7: He shows Moses the ways of Israel’s children along with their laws.
verses.8: May Jehovah’s kindness and compassion extend over us forever, and may His mercy be abundant.
verses.9: He shall not contend forever, nor shall he endure evermore.
verses.10: It wasn’t because of our sins that He did these things to us, nor was it because of our faults that He dealt with us in such a manner.
verses.11: For as the heavens cover the earth, so also His kindness covers those who fear Him.
verses.12: As he moves away from the east, from the place of evil, so does he take away our sins from us.
verses.13: May the Lord have mercy on his children, as he has mercy on those who fear him.
verses.14: For he knew our creations; he remembered that we were indeed created by him.
verses.15: A man is like a bird that spends his days like a falcon in the field; thus, he also flies.
verses.16: For the spirit has passed through it, and it is not yet known where it will go. It still does not know its own place.
verses.17: And the mercy of the LORD shall be upon him forevermore, for his faithfulness and righteousness will be passed down to his descendants.
verses.18: To keep his covenant and to remember his commands, so that they may be carried out.
verses.19: YHWH in the heavens has prepared His throne and His kingdom over all things.
verses.20: May the LORD bless His servants, those who carry out His commands, and those who listen to His voice.
verses.21: May the Lord bless all His servants and those who serve Him.
verses.22: May Jehovah bless all His works, in every place where He rules. I bless Jehovah with my heart.
